invariants.rule: terminal run must-not transition to a different state or running
invariants.positive_case: same terminal digest finalization returns the original report idempotently
invariants.negative_case: a terminal run reopens or changes terminal state

invariants.rule: wait/poll/log must-not count as semantic progress
invariants.positive_case: only business, test, risk, artifact, or decision delta advances progress
invariants.negative_case: logs, waits, polls, or heartbeats extend the run indefinitely

invariants.rule: budget exhaustion must-not remove a Gate/confirmation/invariant
invariants.positive_case: budget exhaustion emits a terminal stop report with Gate state unchanged
invariants.negative_case: supervisor continues by bypassing a Gate, confirmation, or packet invariant

invariants.rule: official lifecycle and StartGuard must-not create or own Supervisor run state
invariants.positive_case: Supervisor creates run under its own generation after verified guarded or bootstrap result
invariants.negative_case: task.py, wrapper or hook writes previous/current run

invariants.rule: packet dispatch must-not bypass dependencies/order or launder predecessor dirty outputs into writable scope
invariants.positive_case: complete graph validation emits stable eligible waves and current digest-bound predecessor outputs remain read-only baseline
invariants.negative_case: a dependent or cyclic slice launches, stale predecessor output is accepted, or dirty_state.unrelated grants writes

invariants.rule: managed budget enforcement must consume runner-observed events and require the matching actively probed provider capability
invariants.positive_case: framed cycle, tool, wait, read and worker events drive immutable counters
invariants.negative_case: a host, legacy path or adapter claim creates hard enforcement or resets usage

invariants.rule: pre-task unrelated and predecessor state must remain exact read-only bytes/modes and submodule gitlink/HEAD/dirty state through every launch and finalize
invariants.positive_case: typed snapshots are unchanged and only the active target set has a delta
invariants.negative_case: a path-only unrelated entry hides a content, mode or submodule mutation

invariants.rule: no family match must-not trigger memory/history scan
invariants.positive_case: no family match makes zero memory and history calls
invariants.negative_case: planner performs broad recall or history scan after a miss

invariants.rule: deterministic trimming must-not drop required artifacts
invariants.positive_case: required artifact overflow is reported explicitly instead of silently trimmed
invariants.negative_case: task contract, current Gate, selected packet, blocker, or required design input is hidden

invariants.rule: memory/reuse must-not override live repository truth
invariants.positive_case: stale candidates are excluded when live digests or repository facts disagree
invariants.negative_case: an older summary replaces current repository evidence

invariants.rule: every context input must-not bypass repository-relative path fencing and deterministic depth/file/byte/kind limits
invariants.positive_case: one planner enforces path, race, type and size limits in stable order
invariants.negative_case: absolute URI traversal symlink binary or direct read enters worker context

invariants.rule: planned context manifest bytes must-not be reported as observed actual reads or token telemetry
invariants.positive_case: managed read events count delivered bytes while host inline remains unknown
invariants.negative_case: planned totals become actual zero or passing evidence

invariants.rule: hard context fencing must require a managed backend with both filesystem isolation and ContextPlanner-owned read proxy
invariants.positive_case: an unplanned managed read is denied and audited
invariants.negative_case: a host, legacy or unisolated worker is called hard fenced
